preconditions.expression: t == int(stdin.splitlines()[0]) and t >= 1 and t <= 10**4
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10^4) representing the number of test cases.
Each test case is preceded by an empty line in the input.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2][::2])
preconditions.description: Each corridor description line contains two integers u_j and v_j (1 ≤ u_j, v_j ≤ n) representing bidirectional corridors.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == k and all(2 <= int(x) <= n for x in line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2][1::2])
preconditions.description: The friends' positions line contains k distinct integers x_i (2 ≤ x_i ≤ n) representing rooms with friends.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= k < n <= 2*10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2][::2] if line.strip() != '')
preconditions.description: For each test case, n (number of rooms) and k (number of friends) satisfy 1 ≤ k < n ≤ 2*10^5.
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2*10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line.strip() in ['-1'] or (stdout_line.strip().isdigit() and 1 <= int(stdout_line.strip()) <= k) for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either '-1' (Vlad wins) or a positive integer m (1 ≤ m ≤ k) representing the minimal number of friends needed to catch Vlad.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_line.strip() == '-1') == (not any(all(neighbor != 1 for neighbor in neighbors) for node, neighbors in tree.items() if node != 1)) for stdout_line, tree in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [build_tree(stdin.splitlines()[2::2][i+1:][::2]) for i in range(0, len(stdin.splitlines()[2::2][::2]), 2)]))
postconditions.description: If there exists at least one leaf node (degree 1) other than room 1, Vlad can win (output '-1'). Otherwise, the answer is the minimal subset size of friends that can intercept Vlad's path to any leaf.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_line.strip() != '-1') == (any(all(neighbor != 1 for neighbor in neighbors) for node, neighbors in tree.items() if node != 1)) for stdout_line, tree in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [build_tree(stdin.splitlines()[2::2][i+1:][::2]) for i in range(0, len(stdin.splitlines()[2::2][::2]), 2)]))
postconditions.description: If no leaf node other than room 1 exists, the answer is the minimal subset size of friends that can intercept Vlad's path to any leaf.

postconditions.expression: all((int(stdout_line.strip()) == m) == (min_subset_size == m) for stdout_line, m, min_subset_size in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(stdin.splitlines()[2::2][i][0]) for i in range(0, len(stdin.splitlines()[2::2][::2]), 2)], [compute_min_subset(stdin.splitlines()[2::2][i+1:][::2], stdin.splitlines()[2::2][i][1].split()) for i in range(0, len(stdin.splitlines()[2::2][::2]), 2)]))
postconditions.description: The output m is the minimal number of friends required to intercept Vlad's path to any leaf node, computed as the smallest subset of friends that can cover all paths from room 1 to any leaf node.
